examined_formations.title: GOOGLE_PLAY_REVIEW_REFUND_CHARGEBACK_DEFENSE
examined_formations.chinese_title: Google Play新拒付责任下的自动抗辩
examined_formations.recent_change: For orders placed after 3 August 2026, Google Play and developers share chargeback costs; developers bear purchase price less service fee plus bank chargeback fees.
examined_formations.monetary_value: Direct retained-revenue value for affected apps, with a new 24-hour response window.
examined_formations.beneficiary_identification: PendingRefundReviewNotification gives a machine event for each reviewable chargeback.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: ReviewRefund API accepts refund preference and purchase-usage evidence.

examined_formations.title: UK_NONUK_VAT_GROUP_REJECTED_CLAIM_RECONSIDERATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 英国境外VAT组历史拒绝退款重审
examined_formations.recent_change: HMRC Revenue and Customs Brief 8 (2026), published 8 September, allows reconsideration of certain VAT-group refund claims refused from 1 January 2021, with requests due by 31 August 2027.
examined_formations.monetary_value: Potentially material historic VAT recovery for affected non-UK businesses.
examined_formations.beneficiary_identification: The decisive universe is not externally enumerable: a claimant needs its HMRC unique reference, claim number, claim period, value and prior decision details.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: HMRC permits agents, but VAT Notice 723A states agents may need HMRC tax-adviser registration.

examined_formations.title: US_IEEPA_TARIFF_REFUND_RECOVERY
examined_formations.recent_change: Following 2026 court decisions, CBP built CAPE functionality in ACE to administer IEEPA tariff refund claims and importers/brokers may need to submit affected entry lists.
examined_formations.monetary_value: Very large importer-level duty recovery can exist across affected entries.
examined_formations.beneficiary_identification: Importer and entry records are machine-structured inside customs systems, but complete entitlement and liquidation posture require importer/broker records.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Execution can require customs broker, protest or litigation handling depending on entry posture and timing.

examined_formations.title: SCOTLAND_2026_RHL_BUSINESS_RATES_RELIEF
examined_formations.chinese_title: 苏格兰2026零售餐旅休闲商业税减免
examined_formations.recent_change: The 2026-27 revaluation cycle introduced/expanded retail, hospitality and leisure relief with up to £110,000 annual cap per business.
examined_formations.beneficiary_identification: Scottish non-domestic property valuations are freely accessible and property use/rateable-value rules create a partially enumerable prospect universe.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: Most reliefs are applied for through local councils.

examined_formations.title: FTC_AMAZON_PRIME_EXPANDED_REDRESS
examined_formations.recent_change: A September 2026 revised order expanded eligibility and raised the maximum total payment to $200.
examined_formations.monetary_value: Large aggregate redress pool and millions of potentially eligible consumers.
examined_formations.beneficiary_identification: Amazon's business records identify eligible consumers.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: No operator action is required or permitted for ordinary recovery; future payments are automatic.

examined_formations.title: UK_SMART_METER_GUARANTEED_STANDARD_COMPENSATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 英国智能电表服务超时自动赔偿
examined_formations.recent_change: From February 2026 new Ofgem rules require £40 compensation for specified installation or resolution failures.
examined_formations.monetary_value: Direct cash compensation exists for affected energy customers.
examined_formations.operator_accessibility: The rule is designed as automatic compensation by suppliers.
